definition_ja: 直線（数直線）上を動く点の運動。位置・速度・加速度が微分で結びつく。
definition_en: Motion of a point along a straight line, in which position, velocity, and acceleration are related by derivatives.

examples.en: For straight-line motion, the particle moves to the right when the velocity is positive.
examples.ja: 直線運動では、速度が正のとき点は右に動く。

examples.en: A particle moves along the x-axis with position x(t) = t³ − 6t² + 9t. When is it moving to the left?
examples.ja: x 軸上を動く点の位置が x(t) = t³ − 6t² + 9t のとき、点が左に動くのはいつか。

pitfalls: AP の CED は topic 4.2 の名前で straight-line motion と言い、本文では rectilinear motion も使う。

sources.title: College Board, AP Calculus AB and BC Course and Exam Description (Effective Fall 2020)
